mapper.select: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('tenant_id',r.tenant_id,'project_id',r.project_id,'run_id',r.run_id,'task_id',r.task_id, 'task_revision',r.task_revision,'execution_kind',r.execution_kind,'registry_kind',e.execution_kind, 'registry_project_id',e.project_id,'budget_revision',r.budget_revision,'status',r.status,'reason_code',r.reason_code, 'started_at',DATE_FORMAT(r.started_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'ended_at',DATE_FORMAT(r.ended_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'), 'revision',CAST(r.revision AS CHAR),'schema_version',r.schema_version,'schema_manifest',r.schema_manifest_sha256, 'dispatch_closed_at',DATE_FORMAT(r.dispatch_closed_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'workflow_id',r.workflow_id, 'superseded_by_run_id',r.superseded_by_run_id) FROM task_run r JOIN execution_registry e ON e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.run_id=r.run_id WHERE r.run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('step_id',s.step_id,'role_version',s.role_version,'section_id',s.section_id,'status',s.status, 'lease_generation',CAST(s.lease_generation AS CHAR),'revision',CAST(s.revision AS CHAR)) FROM run_step s WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY s.step_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('waiting_item_id',w.waiting_item_id,'step_id',w.step_id,'action_id',w.action_id, 'target_revision',w.target_revision,'reason_code',w.reason_code,'question',w.question, 'requirement_refs',w.requirement_refs,'allowed_resolution_actions',w.allowed_resolution_actions, 'assignee_id',w.assignee_id,'status',w.status,'resolution_id',w.resolution_id,'revision',CAST(w.revision AS CHAR)) FROM waiting_item w WHERE w.project_id=#{projectId} AND w.run_id=#{runId} AND w.status='WAITING_INPUT' ORDER BY w.waiting_item_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('invocation_id',i.invocation_id,'step_id',i.step_id,'action_id',i.action_id, 'status',i.status,'settlement_status',i.settlement_status,'currency',i.currency, 'settled_amount',CAST(i.settled_amount AS CHAR),'total_tokens',CAST(i.total_tokens AS CHAR),'revision',CAST(i.revision AS CHAR)) FROM invocation i WHERE i.project_id=#{projectId} AND i.run_id=#{runId} AND (i.status IN ('RESERVED','DISPATCHING','IN_FLIGHT','CANCEL_REQUESTED','UNKNOWN') OR i.settlement_status <> 'SETTLED') ORDER BY i.invocation_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('tenant_id',b.tenant_id,'project_id',b.project_id,'budget_id',b.budget_id, 'budget_revision',r.budget_revision,'currency',r.currency,'account_currency',b.currency, 'spent',CAST(b.spent AS CHAR),'reserved',CAST(b.reserved AS CHAR),'approval',r.limits, 'approver_id',r.approver_id,'reason',r.reason,'content_sha256',r.content_sha256,'registry_sha256',v.content_sha256, 'schema_version',r.schema_version,'schema_manifest',r.schema_manifest_sha256) FROM budget_revision r JOIN budget_account b ON b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.budget_id=r.budget_id JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.version_id=r.budget_revision AND v.entity_kind='BUDGET' AND v.owner_project_id <=> r.project_id WHERE r.budget_revision=#{budgetRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('stream_id',s.stream_id,'sequence',CAST(s.last_sequence AS CHAR),'event_id',e.event_id) FROM stream_registry s LEFT JOIN stream_event e ON e.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND e.stream_id=s.stream_id AND e.sequence=s.last_sequence AND e.project_id=s.project_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.kind='RUN' AND s.owner_resource_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('stream_id',s.stream_id,'sequence',CAST(s.last_sequence AS CHAR)) FROM stream_registry s WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.kind='RUN' AND s.owner_resource_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('sequence',CAST(e.sequence AS CHAR)) FROM stream_event e WHERE e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.stream_id=#{streamId} AND e.event_id=#{eventId} AND e.run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('schema_manifest',e.schema_manifest_sha256,'event',JSON_OBJECT( 'schema_version',e.schema_version,'event_id',e.event_id, 'stream',JSON_OBJECT('stream_id',e.stream_id,'kind','RUN','resource_id',#{runId}), 'sequence',CAST(e.sequence AS CHAR),'event_type',e.event_type,'tenant_id',e.tenant_id,'project_id',e.project_id, 'task_id',e.task_id,'run_id',e.run_id,'resource_kind',e.resource_kind,'resource_id',e.resource_id, 'resource_revision',CAST(e.resource_revision AS CHAR),'occurred_at',DATE_FORMAT(e.occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'payload',e.payload)) FROM stream_event e WHERE e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.stream_id=#{streamId} AND e.run_id=#{runId} AND e.sequence > #{sequence} ORDER BY e.sequence LIMIT 64 FOR UPDATE

choose.when: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind','TASK','id',#{taskId},'project_id',w.project_id) FROM waiting_item w WHERE w.project_id=#{projectId} AND w.waiting_item_id=#{id} AND w.run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind','TASK','id',c.task_id,'project_id',c.project_id) FROM candidate c WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.candidate_id=#{id} AND c.run_id=#{runId} AND c.task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind','DOCUMENT','id',d.document_id,'project_id',d.project_id) FROM document_head d WHERE d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.document_id=#{id} AND d.task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind','SOURCE','id',v.source_id,'project_id',s.owner_project_id) FROM source_version v JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.source_id=v.source_id WHERE v.source_version=#{id} AND (s.owner_project_id IS NULL OR s.owner_project_id=#{projectId}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind','DOCUMENT','id',d.document_id,'project_id',e.project_id) FROM export_manifest e JOIN document_revision_meta d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.document_revision=e.document_revision JOIN document_head h ON h.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND h.project_id=d.project_id AND h.document_id=d.document_id WHERE e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.export_id=#{id} AND h.task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind','PROJECT','id',n.project_id,'project_id',n.project_id) FROM notification n WHERE n.project_id=#{projectId} AND n.notification_id=#{id} AND n.recipient_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
